Hi all — dug in with the ops team. Summary: the approval microservice (plg-approver) failed to pick up the webhook event due to a transient queue routing bug; the event is in SQS DLQ with a 503 neighbor error. We have a short remediation path:

1) Manual grant: we can issue the standard 5000-token trial credit to the account immediately. I’ll need an explicit OK from Emily to proceed. Grant will appear within 2–5 minutes once processed.
2) Temporary extension: if you want extra runway while we fully remediate (it may take another 24–48 hrs for the pipeline reprocess / patch), we can extend the trial expiration by 7 days.

I’ve opened a tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IDEMPOT-9012 and attached the ops playbook for manual grants.

Attachments: grant-instructions.md (ops steps, manual-grant Playbook)

If you give me the go-ahead I’ll execute the grant and confirm with a transaction id.
